question: Should this stacked draft introduce `claws apply --yes` workspace/persona file writes and the public `--workspace` flag before the prerequisite Claws stack and RFC direction have landed?
rationale: The code adds a new mutating CLI path and durable shared-state model, so automation cannot decide the product sequence or permanent schema ownership safely.

options.title: Repair And Continue The Stack
options.body: Fix the workspace ref identity/schema issues, keep the PR draft/protected, and continue maintainer review after the prerequisite Claws branches are accepted.

options.title: Pause Until Prerequisites Land
options.body: Hold this PR until the non-mutating validation branch, artifact-provenance branch, and RFC direction are accepted.

options.title: Fold Into Installer/Remove Slice
options.body: Supersede this draft if maintainers want workspace writes, provenance, install, and remove semantics to land as one later mutating slice.

recommendation.title: Repair And Continue The Stack
recommendation.body: Fix the workspace ref identity/schema issues, keep the PR draft/protected, and continue maintainer review after the prerequisite Claws branches are accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision crosses shared-state schema ownership and a new user-facing CLI mutation surface, where steipete has the strongest recent path-history signal.
